events.title: Challenger is lost
events.description: Seven people die when the shuttle breaks apart after launch. NASA pauses flights and investigates.

events.title: Black Monday hits markets
events.description: The Dow falls 22.6% in one day. The monthly chart combines that day with all the other trading days in October.

events.title: The Berlin Wall opens
events.description: East Germans begin crossing the border freely. The change becomes a powerful symbol of a changing Europe.

events.title: Hubble launches into orbit
events.description: The space telescope leaves Earth aboard Discovery. Its first images later reveal a flaw in the main mirror.

what_happened_next.text: Coca-Cola and Apple finished close together at the top of this set. IBM gained only a little, despite its enormous size. The broad baskets rose too, with international shares ahead of US shares. The five years included a market crash and major world changes. Company trouble at the start did not tell you exactly what its stock would do.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: Apple’s leadership split, Coca-Cola’s formula reversal and plans for a weaker dollar all attracted attention.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: Different companies followed very different paths. Size and reputation did not guarantee high returns, and a bad headline did not settle a company’s future.
reflection.what_faded_away: The immediate tax-bill timetable and the first reactions to a new musical did not determine the final ranking.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: No starting headline revealed that Apple and Coca-Cola would end so close together. Their past difficulties were clues to consider, not a ready-made answer.
